single_graph.jsonld text.stdout:
Ontology linter: 11 finding(s)
[WARNING] LEX001 http://example.org/single#Part: Term has no label.
    Fix: Add rdfs:label or an accepted alternative to the declared local term.
[WARNING] ONT003 http://example.org/single: Ontology has no license annotation.
    Fix: Add dcterms:license (or an agreed equivalent) to the ontology.
[WARNING] ONT006 http://example.org/single: Missing ontology description.
    Fix: Describe the ontology with dcterms:description or rdfs:comment.
[INFO   ] GOV004 http://example.org/single: Ontology names no contact, publisher or maintainer.
    Fix: Add a dcterms:publisher, dcat:contactPoint or foaf:maintainer so users know whom to contact.
[INFO   ] LEX002 http://example.org/single#Part: Term has no description or definition.
    Fix: Add a natural-language definition (rdfs:comment, skos:definition, or dcterms:description).
[INFO   ] LEX002 http://example.org/single#Thing: Term has no description or definition.
    Fix: Add a natural-language definition (rdfs:comment, skos:definition, or dcterms:description).
[INFO   ] LEX002 http://example.org/single#partOf: Term has no description or definition.
    Fix: Add a natural-language definition (rdfs:comment, skos:definition, or dcterms:description).
[INFO   ] ONT004 http://example.org/single: No versionIRI/versionInfo.
    Fix: Add owl:versionIRI or owl:versionInfo according to your release policy.
[INFO   ] ONT005 http://example.org/single: Missing creator and dcterms:created provenance.
    Fix: Add creator and creation date provenance (e.g. dcterms:creator and dcterms:created).
[INFO   ] OWL005 http://example.org/single#partOf: Property has no asserted rdfs:domain.
    Fix: Consider declaring domain or explaining why a global domain is inappropriate.
[INFO   ] OWL006 http://example.org/single#partOf: Property has no asserted rdfs:range.
    Fix: Consider declaring range or explaining why a global range is inappropriate.
